user.title: Sprinklecast
user.description: A live hub uses your weather and stores on/off entities. A simulation hub uses example zones and a weather week you describe. Neither one opens a valve. If Smart Water is still installed, choose Import my Smart Water setup. No YAML is required.

import_legacy.title: Import my Smart Water setup
import_legacy.description: Smart Water is still loaded, so Sprinklecast cannot copy the hub yet. This removes config/custom_components/smart_water. Restart Home Assistant, then open Settings, Add integration, Sprinklecast, and choose Import my Smart Water setup again.

live.title: Sprinklecast hub
live.description: Name the hub, then pick a weather entity or open Sensors and pick a temperature sensor. A Tempest station is filled in when one is found. Location and schedule already have defaults. Automatic watering stays off until you turn the switch on.

data_description.weather_entity:
Optional when a temperature sensor is set. Used for the forecast and for any sensor you leave empty.
Common names: Weather, Forecast, Home, OpenWeatherMap, Met.no, AccuWeather, National Weather Service, Tempest, WeatherFlow.
Units: temperature °C, C, degC, ºC, °F, F, degF, ºF (°F, F, degF, and ºF are converted automatically). Precipitation mm, in, inch, inches (in, inch, and inches are converted automatically). Wind m/s, mph, mi/h, km/h, kph, kmh, kn, kt, knots (mph, mi/h, km/h, kph, kmh, kn, kt, and knots are converted automatically). If the temperature, precipitation, or wind unit is missing or not in that list, that part shows a warning and is ignored. Humidity on the weather entity is percent, because a Home Assistant weather entity reports humidity in % and has no humidity unit. Pressure is not read from the weather entity.
data_description.name: The name shown for this hub or zone.
data_description.send_plan_notifications: On when a notify service is set. Sends the evening plan even when automatic watering is off, so you can see what it would do. Freeze, flow, and budget notices are separate.

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Optional. Open this when you have a Tempest or other local sensors. A temperature sensor here can replace the weather entity.

data_description.temperature_sensor:
Required only if you leave the weather entity empty.
Common names: Temperature, Outdoor temperature, Air temperature, Ambient temperature (Tempest, Ecowitt, Ambient Weather).
Device class: temperature.
Units: °C, C, degC, ºC, °F, F, degF, ºF (°F, F, degF, and ºF are converted automatically). Any other unit, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.pressure_sensor:
Station pressure, not sea-level pressure.
Common names: Station pressure, Pressure, Barometric pressure, Atmospheric pressure (Tempest Station pressure, Ecowitt, Ambient Weather). Prefer station pressure when both station and sea-level exist.
Device class: pressure or atmospheric_pressure.
Units: hPa, mbar, mb, kPa, inHg, psi, mmHg, Pa (converted automatically). Any other unit, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.uv_sensor:
Used only when the solar sensor is empty. About 100 watts per square meter per UV index.
Common names: UV index, UV, Ultraviolet index (Tempest UV index).
Device class: uv_index.
Units: UV index, UV, UVI, index (required). W/m² and lx are not accepted. A missing unit or any other unit shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.rain_amount_sensor:
Preferred over the weather forecast. Daily total matches Tempest rain today.
Common names: Rain today, Precipitation, Daily rain, Rain accumulation, Rain rate (Tempest Rain today, Ecowitt rainfall).
Device class: precipitation.
Units: mm, in, inch, inches (in, inch, and inches are converted automatically). Any other unit, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored. When the rain kind is rate, that depth is per hour. in/h is not accepted.
data_description.rain_kind: Daily total replaces the day's rain. Cumulative adds increases and ignores the first sample. Rate is mm/h, integrated between updates.
data_description.humidity_sensor:
Optional. A local humidity sensor is used before the weather entity.
Common names: Humidity, Relative humidity, Outdoor humidity, RH (Tempest, Ecowitt, Ambient Weather).
Device class: humidity.
Units: % (required). A 0–1 fraction is not accepted. A missing unit or any other unit shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.wind_sensor:
Optional. Wind speed for the water-loss estimate and the wind skip.
Common names: Wind speed, Wind, Sustained wind, Wind average (Tempest Wind speed or Wind average, Ecowitt).
Device class: wind_speed.
Units: m/s, mph, mi/h, km/h, kph, kmh, kn, kt, knots (mph, mi/h, km/h, kph, kmh, kn, kt, and knots are converted automatically). Any other unit, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.solar_radiation_sensor:
Optional. A daily total or a live watts-per-square-meter reading. Used before the UV index.
Common names: Solar radiation, Irradiance, Solar irradiance, Global horizontal irradiance (GHI), Shortwave radiation (Tempest Solar radiation). Illuminance, lux, and brightness are not the same and are ignored.
Device class: irradiance or solar_irradiance.
Units: W/m², W/m2, Wm2, W/m^2 (live irradiance), or any unit containing MJ (daily total). Any other unit, including lx, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.wind_height_m: How high the wind sensor is mounted. The estimate adjusts that speed to 2 meters.

flow_meter.name: Flow meter
flow_meter.description: Optional. One meter for the whole system. A whole-home meter does not alert while nothing is running, because the house uses water too. An irrigation-only meter keeps that alert.

data.flow_idle_action: When flow is seen with every zone off

data_description.flow_sensor:
Optional. One sensor for every zone. Volume total or a flow rate. Water used while a zone is running is counted for that zone.
Common names: Flow rate, Water flow, Flow, Water total, Water usage, Irrigation flow (Flume, Moen Flo, Phyn, Rachio, Hydrawise, Ecowitt).
Device class: water, volume, or volume_flow_rate.
Units: gal, gallon, gallons, L, liter, liters, litre, litres, m³, m3, m^3, ft³, ft3, ft^3, cuft for a volume total (non-gallon units are converted automatically). gal/min, gpm, L/min, lpm, m³/h, m3/h, m^3/h, gal/h, gph for a flow rate (non-gal/min units are converted automatically). A missing unit or any other unit shows a warning and this sensor is ignored. Set Flow sensor kind to match.
data_description.flow_kind: Volume total counts up. Flow rate is gallons or liters per minute.
data_description.flow_scope: Required when a flow sensor is set. Whole-home does not alert while the house is using water. Irrigation-only alerts when water moves and no zone is running.
data_description.flow_idle_gpm: Shown only for an irrigation-only meter. Default 0.5 gal/min, or about 1 gallon on a volume total, while no zone is on.
data_description.flow_idle_action: Notify only, or stop watering and skip every zone until you reset flow learning. Hidden for a whole-home meter.
data_description.learn_flow_minutes: Minimum minutes each zone stays on after the flow meter rises. Default 5 minutes. A slow meter keeps the zone on longer, until two readings from the middle of the run are in. The saved rate is the peak of those readings. The valve report is not the clock.

location.name: Location and schedule
location.description: Defaults match the central Texas design site (about 219 m) and water any day. Automatic watering is a switch and stays off until you turn it on.

data.forecast_skip_mm: Skip when forecast rain is at least
data.freeze_skip_f: Skip when temperature is at or below
data.hub_nightly_cap_min: Optional cap for all zones together
data.forecast_defer_days: Days to wait for forecast rain
data.flow_idle_action: When flow is seen with every zone off

data_description.elevation_m: Used when estimating how much water a reference lawn loses (ET0) and no pressure sensor is set. Home Assistant often stores 0.
data_description.latitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location. Set both latitude and longitude, or neither.
data_description.longitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location.
data_description.notify_target: Example: mobile_app_phone, or notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty sends nothing.
data_description.forecast_skip_mm: Optional depth. Leave empty to wait only when expected rain covers the water the zone needs. Forecast rain is never counted as water already in the soil.
data_description.round_minutes: On keeps every cycle a whole minute. Off keeps tenths of a minute.
data_description.allowed_weekdays: Every day is selected by default. Clear a day to skip it. An empty selection waters no day.
data_description.blackout_start_hour: First local hour when watering is not allowed. Leave empty for no blackout.
data_description.blackout_end_hour: First local hour when watering is allowed again.
data_description.drip_ignores_schedule: Drip may skip the weekday check. The blackout still applies. Off by default.
data_description.freeze_skip_f: Default 40°F (Oklahoma State HLA-6610). Uses the current temperature or the forecast low.
data_description.zone_max_run_min: Default 60. Valve-on minutes for one zone this morning, not all zones together. Soak time does not count. Anything left waits for the next allowed day.
data_description.hub_nightly_cap_min: Leave empty. Set this only to cap every zone's valve-on time together.
data_description.forecast_probability_pct: Default 60%. Only forecast slots at or above this chance count. Expected rain is that chance times the amount.
data_description.forecast_defer_days: Default 2 mornings. After that, water at the next window even if the forecast still looks wet.
data_description.forecast_hours: Default 48 hours. Used for forecast rain and freeze alerts.
data_description.freeze_alert: On by default. One notice per cold snap, separate from the 40°F watering skip.
data_description.freeze_alert_f: Default 32°F. Advises protecting the backflow preventer and exposed pipes.
data_description.hard_freeze_f: Default 28°F. The message says to shut off and drain the irrigation.
data_description.flow_high_pct: Default 30% above the baseline gallons per minute, or the learned rate when no baseline is saved. A broken head or a leak.
data_description.flow_low_pct: Default 25% below the baseline gallons per minute, or the learned rate when no baseline is saved. A clog, a stuck valve, or low pressure.
data_description.flow_learn_runs: Default 3. Alerts wait until this many runs are in the median when no baseline is saved.
data_description.flow_trend_pct: Default 10%. The recent median past this line, above or below the baseline, raises a trend alert. It notifies only.
data_description.flow_trend_runs: Default 5. The trend uses the median of this many latest runs.
data_description.flow_idle_gpm: Default 0.5 gal/min, or about 1 gallon on a volume total, while no zone is on. A main-line leak.
data_description.flow_high_action: Notify only, or skip that zone until you reset flow learning.
data_description.flow_low_action: Notify only, or skip that zone until you reset flow learning.
data_description.flow_idle_action: Notify only, or stop watering and skip every zone until you reset flow learning.
data_description.cost_per_1000_gal: Optional. Adds a cost sensor in dollars for the water dashboard.
data_description.weekly_budget_gal: Optional. Fires one alert per week when use goes over this.
data_description.weekly_summary: Off by default. On Monday, at or after the plan hour, sends one summary.
data_description.rain_sensor:
Optional. An on/off sensor that is on, or a rain-rate reading above the threshold, means it is raining and watering waits. Off, unknown, and unavailable do not skip.
Common names (on/off): Raining, Rain sensor, Is raining, Rain detected.
Common names (rate): Rain rate, Rain intensity, Precipitation intensity, Precipitation rate.
Device class: moisture for on/off; precipitation_intensity for a rate.
Units: none for on/off; in/h or mm/h for rate (converted automatically). Accepted rate units: in/h, in/hr, in/hour, inch/h, inch/hr, inch/hour, inches/h, inches/hr, inches/hour, mm/h, mm/hr, mm/hour. Any other unit on a numeric sensor, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.rain_rate_min: Numeric rain-rate sensors only. A rate above this counts as raining. The default is 0, in the same unit as the sensor, so any positive rate counts. An on/off sensor ignores this.
data_description.plan_hour: The evening hour when today's water loss is saved and the morning plan is built. Default 23.
data_description.max_daily_runtime_min: Optional limit on valve-on minutes for every zone together this morning.

morning.name: Morning watering
morning.description: When the valves may open. Dynamic start time aims to finish at local sunrise. Don't start before is a hard limit in every mode.

data_description.dynamic_start: On for a new hub. The morning aims to finish at local sunrise for that day, so the clock moves with the season and daylight saving. The start is sunrise minus every cycle and every soak. If that would be earlier than Don't start before, watering starts then and may run past sunrise, but it still ends by the finish time. Anything that does not fit waits for the next allowed day. Off uses the start time, and cycles that would pass the finish time wait. The start time is hidden while this is on.
data_description.earliest_start: Hard limit. Watering never starts earlier than this: not with a dynamic start, a fixed start, the year-ahead projection, or a later morning catching up minutes that did not fit. Default 04:00. If the work does not fit, the rest waits for the next allowed day.
data_description.finish_time: Latest the run may end. Default 09:00. With dynamic start on, this is the buffer after sunrise. The run never goes later.
data_description.start_time: Shown only when Dynamic start time is off. Local time the valves open. Default 05:00. Not used while Dynamic start time is on.

simulation.title: Simulation hub
simulation.description: No weather entity, sensor, or on/off entity is required. Pick an example week and how full the soil starts. Zones are dropdowns only and use virtual valves. The week uses the same planner as a live hub and does not open a valve.

data_description.scenario: An example week, not a forecast and not a climate normal. Change it later in options or with the simulate service.
data_description.bucket: Full means the soil is holding all the water it can. Half means half of that is already used. Dry enough to water means it is time to irrigate.
data_description.name: The name shown for this hub or zone.
data_description.send_plan_notifications: On when a notify service is set. Sends the evening plan even when automatic watering is off, so you can see what it would do. Freeze, flow, and budget notices are separate.

location.name: Location and schedule
location.description: Defaults match the central Texas design site (about 219 m) and water any day. The simulated mornings use this start time and these days. A simulation never opens a valve.

reconfigure.title: Update the hub
reconfigure.description: Clear the weather entity only if a temperature sensor is already set under options.

data_description.weather_entity:
Leave empty to remove it. A temperature sensor must remain.
Common names: Weather, Forecast, Home, OpenWeatherMap, Met.no, AccuWeather, National Weather Service, Tempest, WeatherFlow.
Units: temperature °C, C, degC, ºC, °F, F, degF, ºF (°F, F, degF, and ºF are converted automatically). Precipitation mm, in, inch, inches (in, inch, and inches are converted automatically). Wind m/s, mph, mi/h, km/h, kph, kmh, kn, kt, knots (mph, mi/h, km/h, kph, kmh, kn, kt, and knots are converted automatically). If the temperature, precipitation, or wind unit is missing or not in that list, that part shows a warning and is ignored. Humidity on the weather entity is percent, because a Home Assistant weather entity reports humidity in % and has no humidity unit. Pressure is not read from the weather entity.
data_description.name: The name shown for this hub or zone.

zone_count.title: How many zones?
zone_count.description: How many zones should this hub start with? Each one asks for a name, an on/off entity on a live hub, and plant, soil, sprinkler, and sun. Zero creates the hub now. You can add, edit, or remove zones later.

data_description.zones: Default 1. Maximum 24 on this form. More zones can be added from the hub.

zone.title: Zone {index} of {total}
zone.description: Name the zone. A live hub also asks for the on/off entity. Then plant, soil, sprinkler, and sun. After the first zone, those four start filled in from the previous zone, and you can change them. Advanced stays on the zone after the hub is created. Nothing is turned on.

data_description.valve_entity:
Switch, valve, or input boolean. Stored only. A simulation zone uses a virtual valve instead.
Common names: Zone, Valve, Sprinkler, Station (Hydrawise, Rachio, OpenSprinkler).
Domains: switch, valve, input_boolean.
Units: none. Switch and input boolean use on and off. A valve uses open and closed.
data_description.plant_type: Sets how fast the plants use water, the root depth, and how dry the soil may get, unless you override them later.
data_description.soil_type: Sets available water and the intake rate.
data_description.sprinkler_type: Sets the precipitation rate and efficiency. A bubbler asks for a rate on the zone's Advanced step.
data_description.sun_exposure: Scales how fast the plants use water. Full sun leaves it unchanged. After the first zone this starts as the previous zone's choice.
data_description.area_sqft: Optional, on a simulation hub. Used to estimate gallons.
data_description.slope_pct: Optional, on a simulation hub. Blank uses 0%.
data_description.name: The name shown for this hub or zone.

error.name_exists: A zone with this name already exists.

error.latitude_pair: Set both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
error.need_weather: Pick a weather entity or a temperature sensor.
error.flow_scope: A flow meter needs a choice: whole-home or irrigation-only.
error.name_exists: A zone with this name already exists.

abort.imported: Smart Water was imported. Your hubs, zones, soil water, and entity IDs are now Sprinklecast. You can remove sprinklecast: from configuration.yaml if you added it.
abort.import_failed: Sprinklecast could not import Smart Water. Leave the old config entry in place. If the repair cannot delete config/custom_components/smart_water, delete that folder by hand and restart.
abort.restart_to_import: The old Smart Water folder was removed. Restart Home Assistant, then open Settings, Add integration, Sprinklecast, and choose Import my Smart Water setup.

Common names: Flow rate, Water flow, Flow, Water total, Water usage, Irrigation flow (Flume, Moen Flo, Phyn, Rachio, Hydrawise, Ecowitt).
Device class: water, volume, or volume_flow_rate.
Units: gal, gallon, gallons, L, liter, liters, litre, litres, m³, m3, m^3, ft³, ft3, ft^3, cuft for a volume total (non-gallon units are converted automatically). gal/min, gpm, L/min, lpm, m³/h, m3/h, m^3/h, gal/h, gph for a flow rate (non-gal/min units are converted automatically). A missing unit or any other unit shows a warning and this sensor is ignored. Set Flow sensor kind to match.
data_description.flow_kind: Volume total counts up. Flow rate is gallons or liters per minute.
data_description.flow_scope: Required when a flow sensor is set. Whole-home does not alert while the house is using water. Irrigation-only alerts when water moves and no zone is running.
data_description.flow_idle_gpm: Shown only for an irrigation-only meter. Default 0.5 gal/min, or about 1 gallon on a volume total, while no zone is on.
data_description.flow_idle_action: Notify only, or stop watering and skip every zone until you reset flow learning. Hidden for a whole-home meter.
data_description.learn_flow_minutes: Minimum minutes each zone stays on after the flow meter rises. Default 5 minutes. A slow meter keeps the zone on longer, until two readings from the middle of the run are in. The saved rate is the peak of those readings. The valve report is not the clock.

location.name: Location and schedule

data.forecast_skip_mm: Skip when forecast rain is at least
data.freeze_skip_f: Skip when temperature is at or below
data.hub_nightly_cap_min: Optional cap for all zones together
data.forecast_defer_days: Days to wait for forecast rain
data.flow_idle_action: When flow is seen with every zone off

data_description.notify_target: Example: mobile_app_phone, or notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty sends nothing.
data_description.forecast_skip_mm: Optional depth. Leave empty to wait only when expected rain covers the water the zone needs. Forecast rain is never counted as water already in the soil.
data_description.allowed_weekdays: Every day is selected by default. Clear a day to skip it. An empty selection waters no day.
data_description.drip_ignores_schedule: Drip may skip the weekday check. The blackout still applies. Off by default.
data_description.blackout_start_hour: First local hour when watering is not allowed. Leave empty for no blackout.
data_description.blackout_end_hour: First local hour when watering is allowed again.
data_description.freeze_skip_f: Default 40°F (Oklahoma State HLA-6610). Uses the current temperature or the forecast low.
data_description.zone_max_run_min: Default 60. Valve-on minutes for one zone this morning, not all zones together. Soak time does not count. Anything left waits for the next allowed day.
data_description.hub_nightly_cap_min: Leave empty. Set this only to cap every zone's valve-on time together.
data_description.forecast_probability_pct: Default 60%. Only forecast slots at or above this chance count. Expected rain is that chance times the amount.
data_description.forecast_defer_days: Default 2 mornings. After that, water at the next window even if the forecast still looks wet.
data_description.forecast_hours: Default 48 hours. Used for forecast rain and freeze alerts.
data_description.freeze_alert: On by default. One notice per cold snap, separate from the 40°F watering skip.
data_description.freeze_alert_f: Default 32°F. Advises protecting the backflow preventer and exposed pipes.
data_description.hard_freeze_f: Default 28°F. The message says to shut off and drain the irrigation.
data_description.flow_high_pct: Default 30% above the baseline gallons per minute, or the learned rate when no baseline is saved. A broken head or a leak.
data_description.flow_low_pct: Default 25% below the baseline gallons per minute, or the learned rate when no baseline is saved. A clog, a stuck valve, or low pressure.
data_description.flow_learn_runs: Default 3. Alerts wait until this many runs are in the median when no baseline is saved.
data_description.flow_trend_pct: Default 10%. The recent median past this line, above or below the baseline, raises a trend alert. It notifies only.
data_description.flow_trend_runs: Default 5. The trend uses the median of this many latest runs.
data_description.flow_idle_gpm: Default 0.5 gal/min, or about 1 gallon on a volume total, while no zone is on. A main-line leak.
data_description.flow_high_action: Notify only, or skip that zone until you reset flow learning.
data_description.flow_low_action: Notify only, or skip that zone until you reset flow learning.
data_description.flow_idle_action: Notify only, or stop watering and skip every zone until you reset flow learning.
data_description.cost_per_1000_gal: Optional. Adds a cost sensor in dollars for the water dashboard.
data_description.weekly_budget_gal: Optional. Fires one alert per week when use goes over this.
data_description.weekly_summary: Off by default. On Monday, at or after the plan hour, sends one summary.
data_description.rain_sensor:
Optional. An on/off sensor that is on, or a rain-rate reading above the threshold, means it is raining and watering waits. Off, unknown, and unavailable do not skip.
Common names (on/off): Raining, Rain sensor, Is raining, Rain detected.
Common names (rate): Rain rate, Rain intensity, Precipitation intensity, Precipitation rate.
Device class: moisture for on/off; precipitation_intensity for a rate.
Units: none for on/off; in/h or mm/h for rate (converted automatically). Accepted rate units: in/h, in/hr, in/hour, inch/h, inch/hr, inch/hour, inches/h, inches/hr, inches/hour, mm/h, mm/hr, mm/hour. Any other unit on a numeric sensor, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.rain_rate_min: Numeric rain-rate sensors only. A rate above this counts as raining. The default is 0, in the same unit as the sensor, so any positive rate counts. An on/off sensor ignores this.
data_description.plan_hour: The evening hour when today's water loss is saved and the morning plan is built. Default 23.
data_description.max_daily_runtime_min: Optional limit on valve-on minutes for every zone together this morning.
data_description.round_minutes: On keeps every cycle a whole minute. Off keeps tenths of a minute.
data_description.elevation_m: Meters above sea level. Used when estimating how much water a reference lawn loses (ET0) and no pressure sensor is set.
data_description.latitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location. Set both latitude and longitude, or neither.
data_description.longitude: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's location.

location.description: Defaults match the central Texas design site (about 219 m) and water any day. Automatic watering is a switch and stays off until you turn it on.

morning.name: Morning watering
morning.description: When the valves may open. Dynamic start time aims to finish at local sunrise. Don't start before is a hard limit in every mode.

data_description.dynamic_start: On for a new hub. The morning aims to finish at local sunrise for that day, so the clock moves with the season and daylight saving. The start is sunrise minus every cycle and every soak. If that would be earlier than Don't start before, watering starts then and may run past sunrise, but it still ends by the finish time. Anything that does not fit waits for the next allowed day. Off uses the start time, and cycles that would pass the finish time wait. The start time is hidden while this is on.
data_description.earliest_start: Hard limit. Watering never starts earlier than this: not with a dynamic start, a fixed start, the year-ahead projection, or a later morning catching up minutes that did not fit. Default 04:00. If the work does not fit, the rest waits for the next allowed day.
data_description.finish_time: Latest the run may end. Default 09:00. With dynamic start on, this is the buffer after sunrise. The run never goes later.
data_description.start_time: Shown only when Dynamic start time is off. Local time the valves open. Default 05:00. Not used while Dynamic start time is on.

error.flow_scope: A flow meter needs a choice: whole-home or irrigation-only.

user.title: Zone
user.description: On a live hub, pick the on/off entity, plant, soil, sprinkler, and sun. On a simulation hub there is no on/off entity. Optional area and slope are on this step. The next step is optional. Blank means the preset. Nothing is turned on.

data_description.valve_entity:
Switch, valve, or input boolean. Stored only. A simulation zone uses a virtual valve instead and nothing is turned on.
Common names: Zone, Valve, Sprinkler, Station (Hydrawise, Rachio, OpenSprinkler).
Domains: switch, valve, input_boolean.
Units: none. Switch and input boolean use on and off. A valve uses open and closed.
data_description.plant_type: Sets how fast the plants use water, the root depth, and how dry the soil may get, unless you override them.
data_description.soil_type: Sets available water and the intake rate.
data_description.sprinkler_type: Sets the precipitation rate and efficiency. Bubbler has no published rate, so the next step asks for one.
data_description.sun_exposure: Scales how fast the plants use water. Full sun leaves it unchanged.
data_description.area_sqft: Optional. Used to estimate gallons. Leave blank if you do not know it.
data_description.slope_pct: Optional. Blank uses 0%, the NRCS 0–5% intake band.
data_description.name: The name shown for this hub or zone.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Leave a field blank to keep its preset. Root depth {root_depth} in. Water the soil can hold {awc} in/in. Intake {intake} in/hr at {slope}% slope. Allowed dry-out {mad}. Plant water use factor {kc} this month (annual {kc_annual}, sun factor {sun}). Watering rate {precip} in/hr. Efficiency {efficiency}.

plant_overrides.name: Plant and soil
plant_overrides.description: Blank uses the plant and soil preset.

data.moisture_learn: Learn available water from the moisture sensor

data_description.root_depth_in: Inches. Leave blank to keep the plant preset, which is {root_depth} in. The Root depth number uses inches or centimeters, whichever Home Assistant uses for length, and converts centimeters. A value with no unit is rejected. Examples: new Bermuda 4-6 in, established turf 6-12 in, beds 8-12 in.
data_description.awc_override: Preset {awc} in/in. Leave blank to use it. This is how much water the soil can hold (AWC).
data_description.intake_in_hr: Preset {intake} in/hr. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.depletion_fraction: Preset {mad}. Leave blank to use it. This is the allowed dry-out (MAD). The planner still adjusts it for how much water the plants use today.
data_description.kc_override: Preset {kc} for this month, including sun. Leave blank to use it. A number here replaces the plant water use factor (Kc) and the sun factor.
data_description.min_interval_days: Blank uses the plant default (turf 3 days, shrubs and trees 7, vegetables and flowers 2).
data_description.target_depth_in: Blank waits until the soil reaches the watering point (RAW). A number here waters at that depth instead.
data_description.wind_skip_mph: Blank uses the sprinkler default. Drip and bubbler do not skip for wind.
data_description.moisture_skip_pct: Blank skips while the sensor still shows the soil wetter than the allowed dry-out.
data_description.dormant_below_f: Blank uses the grass preset. Non-turf plantings ignore these.
data_description.maintenance_watering: Off unless set. A dormant zone can then take 0.25 in every 21 days when the soil is dry.
data_description.moisture_learn: Blank means on when a moisture sensor is set. The factor stays within 30% of the preset.

hardware_overrides.name: Hardware
hardware_overrides.description: Blank uses the sprinkler preset. Slope blank uses 0%, the NRCS 0–5% band.

data_description.precipitation_rate_in_hr: Preset {precip} in/hr. Leave blank to use it. An entered rate wins over flow and area.
data_description.efficiency: Preset {efficiency}. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.slope_pct: Preset {slope}%. Leave blank to use it.
data_description.max_cycle_min: Leave blank to use the intake rate and precipitation rate.
data_description.soak_min: Leave blank to use the soil default. Drip and bubbler soak 0 unless you set one.
data_description.flow_gpm: Leave blank unless you want the rate calculated from flow and area.
data_description.area_sqft: Used with flow to compute inches per hour (96.25 × GPM / area). Also used for the flow check.
data_description.baseline_minutes: Blank uses 15 minutes. This is a comparison, not a recommendation.
data_description.baseline_days: Blank uses 3 days a week. Gallons saved is this timer minus actual use.
data_description.max_run_min: Blank uses the hub's per-zone cap, 60 minutes unless you changed it.

measurement_overrides.name: Moisture and priority
measurement_overrides.description: Optional. A moisture sensor can correct the soil water and slowly learn how much the soil holds. Low-flow and leak ratios apply to the hub flow meter.

data_description.priority: Lower numbers run first when two zones are both ready.
data_description.moisture_mode: Off ignores the sensor. Adjust blends the reading into the soil water once a day. Replace overwrites the soil water on every update.
data_description.moisture_kind: Percent of the water the soil can hold (0–100, or a 0–1 fraction). A volumetric reading also needs the full-soil number.
data_description.flow_low_ratio: Delivered ÷ expected below this, after the run window, is low flow. Default 0.5. Uses the hub flow meter.
data_description.flow_leak_ratio: Delivered ÷ expected above this is a leak. Default 1.5. Unscheduled delivery of at least 1 gallon is also a leak.
data_description.moisture_sensor:
Optional sensor that reports how full the soil is.
Common names: Soil moisture, Moisture, Soil humidity, VWC, Volumetric water content (Ecowitt, Vegetronix).
Device class: moisture.
Units: %, percent, pct, or a fraction unit (fraction, ratio, 0-1, m³/m³, m3/m3, m^3/m^3, cm³/cm³, cm3/cm3, v/v). A 0–1 number is accepted only when the unit is a fraction unit. The full-soil reading uses that same unit. Any other unit, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.moisture_weight: How strongly a once-a-day correction follows the sensor. 1 follows it fully.
data_description.field_capacity_vwc: The volumetric reading when this soil is full. Used only for a volumetric sensor.
data_description.rain_sensor:
Optional. An on/off sensor that is on, or a rain-rate reading above the threshold, means it is raining and watering waits. Off, unknown, and unavailable do not skip.
Common names (on/off): Raining, Rain sensor, Is raining, Rain detected.
Common names (rate): Rain rate, Rain intensity, Precipitation intensity, Precipitation rate.
Device class: moisture for on/off; precipitation_intensity for a rate.
Units: none for on/off; in/h or mm/h for rate (converted automatically). Accepted rate units: in/h, in/hr, in/hour, inch/h, inch/hr, inch/hour, inches/h, inches/hr, inches/hour, mm/h, mm/hr, mm/hour. Any other unit on a numeric sensor, or a missing unit, shows a warning and this sensor is ignored.
data_description.rain_rate_min: Numeric rain-rate sensors only. A rate above this counts as raining. The default is 0, in the same unit as the sensor, so any positive rate counts. An on/off sensor ignores this.

error.name_exists: A zone with this name already exists.
error.precipitation_rate: Enter a precipitation rate, or both flow and area. Bubblers need one of those. Other sprinklers can leave both blank.

options.correct: Adjust soil water once a day
options.override: Replace soil water on every update

options.relative: Percent of water the soil can hold

calculate_plan.name: Calculate plan
calculate_plan.description: Build this morning's plan. Opens a valve only when automatic watering is already on.

reset_bucket.name: Reset soil water
reset_bucket.description: Set the water a zone still needs to zero, as if the soil were full. Does not open a valve.

set_bucket.name: Set water needed
set_bucket.description: Set how much water a zone still needs, in millimeters or inches. Does not open a valve.

set_soil_water_level.name: Set soil water level
set_soil_water_level.description: Set how full a zone's soil is, from 0 to 100 percent, or set the water it still needs. Updates the plan, the next watering, the schedule, and the calendar. Does not open a valve.

mark_watered.name: Mark watered
mark_watered.description: Credit net irrigation that already happened. Does not open a valve.

skip_zone.name: Skip zone
skip_zone.description: Leave a zone out of the plan through a date.

pause_zone.name: Pause zone
pause_zone.description: Skip a zone for a number of days. Zero clears the pause. Does not open a valve.

set_adjustment.name: Set adjustment
set_adjustment.description: Scale how much water a zone gets. 100 is unchanged. Does not open a valve.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Run this zone now, even when automatic watering is off. Freeze, wind, and rain still apply.

simulate.name: Simulate a week
simulate.description: Play a weather week through the planner. Does not open a valve or change the stored soil water.

stop_all.name: Stop all watering
stop_all.description: Turn off any zone Sprinklecast currently has on.

reset_learning.name: Reset moisture learning
reset_learning.description: Set a zone's learned available-water factor back to 1.

reset_flow_learning.name: Reset flow learning
reset_flow_learning.description: Clear learned flow, the flow alert, and a skip that is waiting for reset. The baseline stays unless clear baseline is on.

water_next_chance.name: Water next chance
water_next_chance.description: Arm one watering on the next allowed morning, even if no zone has reached its watering point. Refill estimated need fills today's deficit. Fill completely fills the whole root zone from empty. Rain, freeze, wind, and the other skips still apply. If this morning is skipped, it stays armed. It clears after it runs and it is kept across a restart. Leave the zone empty to arm every zone.

cancel_water_next_chance.name: Cancel water next chance
cancel_water_next_chance.description: Clear an armed Water next chance run. Does not open a valve.

learn_flow_rates.name: Learn flow rates
learn_flow_rates.description: Run each selected zone and save the peak flow from the middle as Baseline flow. The clock starts when the flow meter rises, not when the valve entity reports open. Default minimum is the hub's learn-flow minutes, or 5. A slow meter extends the run until two middle readings are captured. The next zone waits until the meter falls. Does not open a valve until you press it. Does not change the precipitation rate. Stop all watering cancels it.

run_catch_cup_test.name: Run catch-cup test
run_catch_cup_test.description: Run each selected zone once for the given minutes. No soak, no runtime cap, and no soil credit until a cup depth is entered. Rain and other safety stops still apply.

set_catch_cup_result.name: Set catch-cup result
set_catch_cup_result.description: Save the average cup depth. The precipitation rate is depth divided by minutes, times 60, and it replaces the zone preset. Does not open a valve.

set_flow_baseline.name: Set flow baseline
set_flow_baseline.description: Save a zone's gallons per minute as its permanent baseline. Leave gallons per minute empty to use the last run. Clears the trend history.

start_audit.name: Start catch-cup audit
start_audit.description: Run a zone for a set time so you can measure cups. Safety and the runtime cap still apply.

submit_audit.name: Submit catch-cup audit
submit_audit.description: Enter cup readings to store a measured precipitation rate and distribution uniformity.

unknown_unit.title: {field} unit is not accepted
unknown_unit.description: {entity} reports {unit}. Accepted units: {accepted}. Sprinklecast is ignoring this reading until the unit is one of those.

flow_alert.title: Flow alert for {name}
flow_alert.description: {detail} Reset flow learning when the zone should run again. The baseline stays unless you clear it.

flow_check_replaced.title: Flow check is now Flow problem
flow_check_replaced.description: The old Flow check sensor was removed. Each zone now has Flow problem, a problem sensor. Off is normal. On means the last run or the recent trend is outside the saved baseline. With no baseline yet it stays off, and the reason is on the sensor. The last result stays across a restart.

flow_diagnostics_removed.title: Extra flow sensors were removed
flow_diagnostics_removed.description: Learned flow and Flow trend are no longer separate sensors. Baseline flow is the expected rate: the catch-cup or saved baseline, or the rate learned from normal runs when no baseline is saved (source learned). Last run flow and Flow vs baseline stay. The trend status, drift percent, and sentence are attributes on Flow problem.

remove_smart_water_folder.title: Delete the old Smart Water folder
remove_smart_water_folder.description: Sprinklecast replaced Smart Water. config/custom_components/smart_water is still on disk, so Home Assistant can keep loading it. Submit this repair to delete that folder, then restart. Do not remove Sprinklecast in HACS. That deletes the new folder.

abort.delete_failed: Sprinklecast could not delete config/custom_components/smart_water. Delete that folder with the File editor or Samba, then restart.
abort.restart_required: The old folder was removed. Restart Home Assistant. If the hub has not moved yet, open Settings, Add integration, Sprinklecast, and choose Import my Smart Water setup.

confirm.title: Delete the old Smart Water folder
confirm.description: This deletes config/custom_components/smart_water and leaves Sprinklecast in place. Restart Home Assistant when it finishes.

smart_water_still_loaded.title: Smart Water is still installed
smart_water_still_loaded.description: Delete config/custom_components/smart_water and restart Home Assistant. Sprinklecast will then keep your hub, zones, stored history, and entity IDs. Do not delete the Smart Water config entry yourself. Do not remove Sprinklecast in HACS.

abort.delete_failed: Sprinklecast could not delete config/custom_components/smart_water. Delete that folder with the File editor or Samba, then restart.
abort.restart_required: The old folder was removed. Restart Home Assistant, then open Settings, Add integration, Sprinklecast, and choose Import my Smart Water setup.

confirm.title: Delete the old Smart Water folder
confirm.description: Smart Water is still loaded. This deletes config/custom_components/smart_water. Restart Home Assistant, then import the hub from Add integration if it has not moved yet.

smart_water_import_failed.title: Smart Water could not be moved
smart_water_import_failed.description: Sprinklecast could not copy the old hub. Leave the Smart Water config entry in place, delete config/custom_components/smart_water, and restart. If this stays, report the log line that starts with Sprinklecast could not import.
